propositions: AGENTS.md incorrectly states an unconditional preference for LSP symbol tools over grep, but LSP cannot resolve symbols passed as string literals (e.g., monkeypatch.setattr, getattr, importlib) which are common in test code

The documented rule caused missed references during story S1: agents following only LSP-based search would not have found the string-literal monkeypatch call that failed in full-suite pre-flight testing
LSP indices can lag behind recent edits in the working tree, causing reported line numbers to become stale within the same session
grep produces false positives (e.g., comment matches) that LSP avoids, but is the only tool for finding string-literal symbol references

Replace the bare preference with a decision table specifying which tool to use for each search scenario: LSP for semantic references, grep for string-literal names and current line numbers in the working tree
